'''Aaryan Shukla''' (born 6 July 2010) is one of the leading [[mental calculator]] representing India in the international competitions. He is practicing Mental Math and Calculation since the age of 6 years.{{citation needed|date=May 2026}}

Aaryan has won the [[Mental Calculation World Cup]] in 2022 in Germany at the age of 12. Aaryan successfully defended his title in 2024 by winning Mental Calculation World Cup for the 2nd time. He has also won many international titles in the past and created multiple world records including 9 Guinness World Records (GWR) in various disciplines of mental calculation.

Aaryan is [[board member]] of the Global Mental Calculators Association.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mentalcalculation.org/aaryan-shukla|title=Aaryan Shukla|website=GMCA}}</ref>
== Career ==
Shukla won the 2022 [[Mental Calculation World Cup]] at the age of 12 years old,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bluewin.ch/de/news/international/zwoelfjaehriger-inder-gewinnt-wm-im-kopfrechnen-1303602.html|title=Zwölfjähriger Inder gewinnt WM im Kopfrechnen|website=blue News}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.rainews.it/tgr/tagesschau/articoli/2022/07/tag-Zwoelfjaehriger-Inder-gewinnt-WM-im-Kopfrechnen-25bb2730-3357-4e8c-8a6d-223f1636f050.html|title=Zwölfjähriger Inder gewinnt WM im Kopfrechnen|first=T. G. R.|last=Tagesschau|date=July 17, 2022|website=RaiNews}}</ref> setting event records in multiplication and square roots in the process. Additionally, during the record attempts portion of the event, he broke the organizer's record for division<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.recordholders.org/en/list/mental-calculation-rankings.html|title=Mental Calculation World Ranking Lists|website=www.recordholders.org}}</ref> and multiplied two 20-digit numbers together in 1 minute and 45 seconds.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://worldmentalcalculation.com/2022/07/19/mental-calculation-world-cup-2022-results/|title=Mental Calculation World Cup 2022: Results – World Mental Calculation|date=July 31, 2022}}</ref>

Shukla returned to the [[Mental Calculation World Cup]] in 2024, winning the event for a second consecutive time, while winning all five categories and scoring more points per category than any prior competitor.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://education21.in/aaryan-shukla-of-dps-nashik-crowned-at-mental-calculation-world-cup-2024/|title=Aaryan Shukla of DPS Nashik crowned at Mental Calculation World Cup −2024 – Education21}}</ref> Additionally, he set the following records during the event:

# [[Mental Calculation World Cup]] calendar date record (answered all 100 dates given correctly in 1 minute)
# [[Mental Calculation World Cup]] multiplication record (breaking his prior record)
# [[Mental Calculation World Cup]] square roots record (breaking his prior record) (answered all 90 problems given with 86 correct and 4 incorrect)
# World record for addition (addition of 10 10-digit numbers, with an average time of 7.808 seconds over 10 questions)
# World record for square roots (square root of 6-digit numbers to 8 significant digits, with an average time 33.78 seconds over 10 questions)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://worldmentalcalculation.com/2024/09/20/mental-calculation-world-cup-2024-results/|title=Mental Calculation World Cup 2024: Results – World Mental Calculation|date=September 22, 2024}}</ref>

Shukla also became the youngest winner at the [[Mind Sports Olympiad|Mind Sport Olympiad Mental Calculation]] World Championship in 2021,<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mindsportsolympiad.com/aaryan-shukla-wins-2021-mental-calculations-world-championship/|title=Aaryan Shukla Wins 2021 Mental Calculations World Championship|date=September 4, 2021}}</ref> before finishing as runner-up twice.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://worldmentalcalculation.com/2023/03/06/mso-mental-calculations-world-championship-2023-results/|title=MSO Mental Calculations World Championship 2023 Results – World Mental Calculation|date=March 21, 2023}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://worldmentalcalculation.com/2024/04/15/mso-mental-calculations-world-championship-2024-results/|title=MSO Mental Calculations World Championship 2024 Results – World Mental Calculation|date=April 16, 2024}}</ref> He also finished as runner-up in Season 1 of Calculation League.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mentalcalculation.org/league-standings|title=Calculation League Standings|website=GMCA}}</ref>

In 2023 and 2024, Shukla gave televised [[Flash Anzan]] performances in [[Russia]] and [[Italy]], the latter earning him a [[Guinness World Records|Guinness World Record]] in addition.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2024/4/human-calculator-kid-can-do-impossible-sums-in-his-head-at-lightning-speed-768357|title='Human Calculator Kid' can do 'impossible' sums in his head at lightning speed &#124; Guinness World Records}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/news/story/class-8-dps-student-sets-guiness-world-record-for-fastest-mental-addition-2522657-2024-04-03|title=12-year-old Aaryan Shukla sets Guiness &#91;sic&#93; World Record for fastest mental addition|date=April 3, 2024|website=India Today}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://aventurasnahistoria.com.br/noticias/historia-hoje/indiano-de-13-anos-bate-recorde-e-e-considerado-calculadora-humana.phtml|title=Indiano de 13 anos bate recorde e é considerado 'calculadora humana'|first=Éric|last=Moreira|date=April 11, 2024|website=Aventuras na História}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/12-year-old-indian-student-breaks-records-with-lightning-fast-mental-addition/|title=12-year-old Indian student breaks records with lightning-fast mental addition|date=April 3, 2024|website=ARAB TIMES – KUWAIT NEWS}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1c_wwjZn7MQ|title=Human Calculator Aaryan Shukla created Guinness World Records (GWR)|date=March 25, 2024|via=YouTube}}</ref>

In late 2024, Shukla set six new Guinness World records in a single day – three related to Flash Anzan, two related to multiplication, and one related to division – in a showcase event in Dubai. <ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/news/2025/2/human-calculator-kid-shatters-six-world-records-with-incredibly-speedy-mental-maths|title=‘Human Calculator Kid’ shatters six world records with incredibly speedy mental maths|date=February 12, 2025|website=Guinness World Records}}</ref>
